name: The Trogg Threat
summary: At Loch Modan’s Southern Gate, Captain Rugelfuss faces a growing trogg threat with too few defenders. The Ironforge Reserve has been called away to Alliance battlefronts, leaving him to hold the pass while troggs threaten the nearby hills.

sections.title: A Depleted Frontier
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers and the Ironforge Reserve have gone to reinforce Alliance battlefronts. Captain Rugelfuss now has only a small garrison. Strict orders keep him at the gate, unable to lead an attack into the highlands. Settlers and travelers there remain exposed to ambushes.

sections.title: Stemming the Tide
sections.body: Troggs in the nearby crags threaten Khaz Modan. Left unchecked, their numbers grow quickly, and they could overrun dwarven outposts. Rugelfuss calls for help to buy time and thin their ranks. Strike at the troggs in their hillside warrens, then bring back their stone teeth as proof.

faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss is a dwarven military officer in the guard tower at Loch Modan’s Southern Gate. With only a small garrison, he must secure the pass against intruders.

faq.q: Why is the Southern Gate understaffed?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Reserve has been sent to fight on distant Alliance battlefronts. Only a small force remains at the gate, bound to its defensive post and unable to strike back.
Trogg Stone Teeth are the troggs’ naturally petrified, stone-like teeth, a mark of their subterranean, earthen heritage. Rugelfuss requires them as proof that troggs have been slain.

aliases: where are troggs for this quest
faq.answer: Troggs live in the rocky hills, ravines and excavation sites beside the road near Loch Modan’s Southern Gate.

faq.q: Why are the troggs such a threat right now?
faq.answer: Troggs multiply quickly and attack fiercely to defend their territory. With troops diverted, they can overrun inhabited lands and threaten the passes linking Loch Modan to neighboring territories.

faq.q: How does completing this quest aid King Magni Bronzebeard?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard is responsible for the safety of all Khaz Modan. Thinning the troggs while Ironforge’s armies fight abroad helps protect internal supply lines and vulnerable frontier settlements.

angles.text: As a dwarf, thinning the troggs near the Southern Gate is a direct duty to Khaz Modan. King Magni Bronzebeard himself will praise you for it.
As an Alliance member, you see how commitments in distant lands have left local garrisons like Loch Modan without their defensive reserves.
